title: EphemLabel
description: Label of ephem.bin, the Sun/Earth timetable (Contract 1). ephem.bin holds `count` rows of six little-endian Float32 values in the order of `columns`. Row i is at time t0_ms + i * step_s * 1000.

version.description: Format version of this file. Increased on any format change.

t0_ms.description: UTC time of row 0, milliseconds since 1970-01-01.

step_s.description: Time between rows, seconds. Read it from here; do not assume a value.

columns.description: The six values of each row, in order: the vector from the centre of the Moon to the Sun, then to the Earth.

origin.description: The vectors start at the centre of the Moon.

aberration.description: SPICE correction used; positions are apparent (light time and stellar aberration corrected).
